cells.v: Smallest of six published quantisations at 516 MB. Autoregressive despite the size: the GGUF declares a causal decoder with a codebook refinement head, and syntheses vary run to run. Across three free-seed runs the six variants span 6.5-7.4% mean WER while a single variant swings up to 2.4%, so the ladder is not separable - precision buys memory, not accuracy.
The same 3B at q8: half a point more accurate than q4 and slower, which is the ordering a sound conversion gives.
